newsitem.title: FRANCE: France lauches probe of Brittany separatist blasts.
newsitem.headline: France lauches probe of Brittany separatist blasts.

text.p: A French anti-terrorism magistrate has launched a probe into a series of bombings in Brittany over the past five years claimed by the separatist Breton Revolutionary Army (ARB), justice sources said on Wednesday.

The sources said the investigation, led by Paris judge Gilbert Thiel, focused on nine attacks since 1991 against the inland revenue, electricity utility EDF, para-military gendarmerie police and the Rennes law courts among others.
The ARB has claimed responsibility for the nine attacks as well as eight others, none of which caused any deaths.
Thiel's probe alleges destruction of property with explosives and criminal conspiracy. The other bombings are already under investigation by judges in Paris and Brittany.
The ARB, set up in 1970, has waged a bombing campaign which climaxed in the 1980s and which included an attack on a wing of the former royal palace at Versailles outside Paris.
